overview.title: Beyond Just Tablature: Theory-Based Song Learning
overview.text: Learning songs is one of the most enjoyable aspects of playing guitar, but simply reading tablature only scratches the surface. Our approach teaches you to understand why songs work the way they do, connecting every riff, chord, and technique to fundamental music theory concepts. By analyzing songs through the lens of theory, you'll develop the skills to:
bulletItems: Understand why certain scales work over progressions
Learn songs faster by recognizing patterns
Write your own songs using proven formulas
